points.label: Oil pipelines (lines)
points.notes: Line layer docs/data/lines_pipelines.geojson; includes proposed GEM routes (status field). Temporal: snapshot (valid_from/valid_to null) - routes exist through the window; flow interruptions are recorded on the oil-field periods (points_oil).

points.label: PoC sites, IDP & refugee camps (status over time)
points.source: Curated: OSM (HOT/HDX) coordinates; UNMISS / UNHCR / IOM public site lists; UNMISS press releases on PoC redesignation (2020-21)
points.notes: Temporal: one feature per site and status period. PoC -> IDP camp redesignation: Bor & Wau Sep 2020 (documented), Juba PoC1/3 Nov 2020 and Bentiu Mar 2021 (month approximate); Wau former PoC closed 2021 (month unknown); Malakal stays a PoC site; Renk transit centre from Apr 2023. Other camps opened before 2018 and are open-ended. Logistics hubs moved to the logcluster_hubs layer. `coord_quality` flags approximate positions. Not exhaustive (see DTM layer).

points.label: IOM Flow Monitoring points (active months)
points.source: IOM DTM South Sudan Flow Monitoring Registry (team unified dataset)
points.notes: Where FMR counts travellers; FMR numbers depend on these locations. Temporal: valid_from/valid_to = first/last month with recorded internal forced trips (Jan 2020-Aug 2025); >6 empty months split a point into periods; Nov 2023-Dec 2024 (no public data) is bridged. Points still active in Aug 2025 are open-ended. active_months / travellers summarise each period.

points.label: Health facilities (hospital / PHCC / PHCU)
points.source: WHO / MoH Master Facility List, April 2025 (HDX); MoH HF code list 2023
points.notes: Point per facility with type; functionality not reported. Some listed facilities lack coordinates (counted in county totals only). Temporal: SNAPSHOT (snapshot=true) - valid_from = list date (2023-01 if already in the 2023 MoH code list, else 2024-03), valid_to null; no opening/closure dates exist.

points.label: Insecurity Insight incidents (aid workers, health, education, CRSV)
points.source: Insecurity Insight (Security in Numbers Database) via HDX, CC BY-SA 4.0
points.notes: One point per incident 2018-2025 with `date`, `type`, `victims`. LOW GEOLOCATION PRECISION: the source censors coordinates, so points sit at the centroid of the reported state / administrative area (`geo_precision`), stacked on top of each other - do not read them as incident locations. Records with no state ('No Information') or outside South Sudan are dropped from the layer. Temporal: event layer - single `date`; valid_from = valid_to = its month (date verified 2018-01..2025-12).

points.label: Logistics Cluster hubs & common storage (over time)
points.source: WFP Logistics Cluster, South Sudan Concept of Operations maps Jan 2018 - Jun 2026 (16 dated maps)
points.notes: Temporal: one feature per site and period with constant storage capacity/manager; valid_from/valid_to from consecutive map dates (2018-01, 2019-01/06/09, 2020-03/04/08, 2021-05/10, 2022-09, 2023-01/04/09, 2026-02/03/06). No map Oct 2023-Jan 2026: sites carried through (date_basis says so). type = Logistics Cluster hub (coordination/transport services) / cluster common storage / partner-managed MSU; storage_m2 as printed. Coordinates = town (OCHA gazetteer) or map pin (coord_quality='approximate'), not the warehouse itself.

points.label: WFP monitored markets (active months)
points.notes: Temporal: valid_from/valid_to = first/last month with retail prices 2018-01..2025-12; gaps longer than 6 months split a market into separate periods. valid_from null = already monitored before 2018. months_with_prices counts reporting months within the period.

points.label: Oil fields (production status over time) and wells
points.source: Global Energy Monitor GOGET (CC-BY 4.0) + OpenStreetMap wells (ODbL); status dates from Reuters/Bloomberg (2018-19 restarts) and Argus/Radio Tamazuj (2024 Dar Blend export halt, 2025 resumption)
points.notes: Temporal: oil fields get one feature per production_status period - Toma South shut in until Aug 2018, Unity until Dec 2018 (Dec 2013 war); Palogue/Qamari (Dar Blend) export disruption Feb-Dec 2024 after the pipeline rupture in Sudan, resumed Jan 2025; Tharjath shut 2013, restart undated (static). OSM wells: snapshot only (no dates).

points.label: Schools
points.source: SSSAMS 2015 (HDX, CC0) + OpenStreetMap education facilities (HOT/HDX, ODbL)
points.notes: SSSAMS points carry type and 2015 enrolment by sex (year=2015); OSM points year=2026. The two sources overlap (duplicates possible). Temporal: SNAPSHOT (snapshot=true, valid_from/valid_to null) - no opening/closure dates in either source.

points.label: UCDP GED conflict events (2018-2025)
points.notes: Organized-violence events with >=1 death. type: state_based / non_state / one_sided; deaths = best estimate; where_prec 1=exact .. 3=county, >=4 coarse (admin-1/country). oil_related = keyword match on oil fields/pipelines (1 inside SSD; 5 cross-border oil events e.g. Heglig added with inside_ssd=false). Temporal: event layer - single `date`; valid_from = valid_to = its month (date verified 2018-01..2025-12).

points.label: UNMISS peacekeeping deployments (over time)
points.source: Geo-PKO v2.3 (UN maps 4456 Rev.30 Nov 2017 .. Rev.61 Oct 2024) + UN Geospatial map 4456 Rev.62 (Jan 2025) and Rev.67 (Jan 2026)
points.notes: One feature per location and period with constant role / troop estimate (rounded to 10) / FPU presence; valid_from/valid_to from consecutive 4456 map revisions (38 maps). troops_est = Geo-PKO estimate from unit sizes (approximate); fpu_present = formed police unit at location. 2025 periods from Rev.62 have no troop numbers. Closures: Aweil Nov 2025 (documented), Yei & Torit between Jul 2025 (Rev.65) and Jan 2026 (Rev.67) -> valid_to 2025-12; Tambura closed Jan 2026 (open through 2025). PoC sites: see crisis-sites layer.

points.label: Water points (WPDx, last known status)
points.source: Water Point Data Exchange WPDx-Basic (OCHA/WASH WIMS 2006-13, ACF/RWSS 2016, Water for South Sudan 2011-15, UNHCR 2019), CC BY 4.0
points.notes: Temporal: valid_from = install year if >= 2018 (none in the data: install years <= 2015 or unknown) else null; valid_to null (decommissioning not recorded). status = functional status at status_report_date; almost all reports predate 2018 (status_stale=true: last known status, not current). UNHCR camp points reported Sep 2019 get a separate status period from 2019-09. Not a complete inventory of current water points.

rasters.label: Burned area (monthly)
rasters.source: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
rasters.notes: Transparent = not burned this month; grey = unmapped/no data. Value = share of 500 m pixels burned inside each display pixel.

rasters.label: Cattle density (GLW4, 2015)
rasters.source: FAO Gridded Livestock of the World v4 (2015), dasymetric

rasters.label: Rainfall (CHIRPS v3)
rasters.source: CHIRPS v3.0 monthly (Climate Hazards Center, UCSB)
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale 0 .. 98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months; bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: Flood / surface water (monthly, Sentinel-1 SAR)
rasters.native_resolution: 10 m Sentinel-1 RTC read at 160 m, classified on a 0.004 deg (~440 m) grid
rasters.source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 IW GRD RTC (sentinel-1-rtc) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
rasters.notes: Flooded = VV-VH ratio > 3.0 dB above the pixel's dry-season (March) reference, or open water (VV<-18.0, VH<-24.0 dB). Sees through cloud. Transparent = dry land; grey = no acquisition within 2 months.

rasters.label: Water storage anomaly (GRACE/GRACE-FO)
rasters.source: GFZ GravIS COST-G GRACE/GRACE-FO Level-3 TWS
rasters.notes: Anomaly vs the 2002–2020 mean. Brown = less water stored than usual, teal = more. ~300 km blur.

rasters.label: NDVI, monthly 1 km (MODIS MOD13A3)
rasters.nodata_color: #bebebe (semi-transparent: no valid retrieval / fill e.g. open water)
rasters.source: MODIS MOD13A3 v061 via NASA AppEEARS

rasters.label: Annual evapotranspiration (MODIS)
rasters.native_resolution: 500 m MODIS, rendered from ~1 km (0.01°) grid
rasters.source: MODIS MOD16A3GF v061 (annual, gap-filled) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
rasters.notes: Annual product: one image per year, file named YYYY-07.png.

rasters.label: Evapotranspiration, monthly (MODIS MOD16A2GF)
rasters.nodata_color: #bebebe (semi-transparent: no valid retrieval / fill e.g. open water)
rasters.native_resolution: 500 m MODIS (8-day, gap-filled), rendered from ~1 km (0.01°) grid
rasters.source: MODIS MOD16A2GF v061 via NASA AppEEARS

rasters.label: Daytime land surface temperature (MODIS)
rasters.source: MODIS MOD11A2 v061 (Terra) via Microsoft Planetary Computer

rasters.label: NDVI (MODIS, monthly max)
rasters.native_resolution: 500 m MODIS, rendered from ~1 km (0.01°) grid
rasters.source: MODIS MOD13A1/MYD13A1 v061 via Microsoft Planetary Computer

rasters.label: Population density 2020
rasters.source: WorldPop Global2 R2025A constrained 1 km

rasters.label: Sentinel-5P aerosol_index (monthly, sampled orbits)
rasters.source: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI L2 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
rasters.notes: Mean of 4-6 sampled orbits per month; grey = no valid retrieval.

rasters.label: Sentinel-5P co (monthly, sampled orbits)
rasters.source: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI L2 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
rasters.notes: Mean of 4-6 sampled orbits per month; grey = no valid retrieval.

rasters.label: Sentinel-5P no2 (monthly, sampled orbits)
rasters.source: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI L2 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
rasters.notes: Mean of 4-6 sampled orbits per month; grey = no valid retrieval.

rasters.label: Sudd inundation (MODIS, monthly)
rasters.colormap: categorical: dry / flooded vegetation / open water
rasters.source: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 (Terra) 8-day via Microsoft Planetary Computer; MCD43A4 NBAR for 12 missing Terra tile-composites (Sep-Oct 2022, Jan and Nov 2023)
rasters.notes: Sudd AOI only (16 counties); transparent outside. A pixel's class is the day-weighted majority over the month's 8-day composites after gap filling (cloudy pixels: last clear state <=24 days, else same-composite 2018-2025 climatology). 2025-07..2025-11 missing: no MODIS on Planetary Computer for 4 Jul-24 Nov 2025.

rasters.label: Surface water (monthly, MODIS)
rasters.source: MODIS MOD09A1/MYD09A1 v061 via Microsoft Planetary Computer; MNDWI(B4,B7)>0.1 in >=50% of clear obs
rasters.notes: Transparent = dry land; grey = no clear observation within 2 months (cloud). Open water + shallow inundation; dense flooded vegetation (papyrus) is under-detected.

rasters.label: Actual evapotranspiration
rasters.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale = 2nd-98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months; bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: Climatic water deficit
rasters.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale = 2nd-98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months; bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: Palmer Drought Severity Index
rasters.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale = 2nd-98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months (symmetric about 0); bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: Precipitation (TerraClimate)
rasters.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale = 2nd-98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months; bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: Soil moisture (TerraClimate)
rasters.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale = 2nd-98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months; bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: Max temperature (TerraClimate)
rasters.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale = 2nd-98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months; bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: Wind speed (10 m)
rasters.source: TerraClimate v1.1 (Abatzoglou et al. 2018) via NKN THREDDS
rasters.notes: Fixed colour scale = 2nd-98th percentile of all in-country pixels over all months; bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857.

rasters.label: VIIRS active fires (S-NPP, per 0.05° cell)
rasters.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m standard processing (VNP14IMGTDL SP)
rasters.notes: Colour = log10(number of nominal/high-confidence vegetation-fire detections in each 0.05° cell that month): 0 = 1 detection, 1 = 10, 2 = 100+. Transparent = no detection.
